title: Seal in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='19' ry='12' fill='#b9d4e6'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#6d92b3'/>

  <path d='M30 54 Q50 62 70 54 L70 64 Q50 72 30 64 Z' fill='#e8544a'/>
  <!-- scarf stripe -->
  <path d='M32 58 Q50 65.5 68 58 L68 61 Q50 68.5 32 61 Z' fill='#ffd24a'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M66 62 Q76 66 78 78 Q74 82 70 80 Q70 70 63 66 Z' fill='#d9463d'/>
  <!-- flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='70' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#4d6f8f' transform='rotate(20 22 70)'/>
